events.body:
## Context

`web_client/index.html` declares `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`, but `showBrokerDetails` in `app.js` only sets `display:block`: focus never moves in, isn't trapped and isn't restored on close. The password input has only a placeholder.

## What to do

1. On open, remember `document.activeElement` and focus the close button; keep Tab inside; on close (button, backdrop, Escape) restore focus.
2. Point `aria-labelledby` at the dialog heading.
3. Add `<label for="password" class="sr-only">Encryption password</label>`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Keyboard-only: Enter opens with focus inside, Esc closes and returns focus
- [ ] Dialog title is announced
- [ ] Password field has an accessible name

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-vanish/cloudflare_workers && npx wrangler dev   # open http://localhost:8787
```
